exposure: pre-cesarean delivery temporary occlusion of internal iliac arteries with balloon catheters
cohort: 37 women with an US and/or MRI diagnosis of placenta previa-accreta and a planned delivery
finding: Prophylactic balloon catheterization before cesarean delivery in women with placenta previa-accreta reduced intraoperative blood loss, lessened perioperative hemostatic measures and intraoperative red cell transfusions, and reduced hysterectomies, without significant differences in neonatal outcomes.
